result.summary: The page is generally polished, but horizontal carousel content is visibly clipped at the right edge, making some restaurant information look cut off rather than cleanly contained.

issues.description: In the “Fastest near you” horizontal list, the third restaurant card and its title (“Trattoria Picco…”) are cut off by the right viewport edge. The partially visible category chip on the row above has the same abrupt clipping.
issues.suggestion: Use intentional carousel affordances such as consistent partial-card previews with adequate right padding, a fade/gradient edge treatment, or ensure text truncates cleanly within the visible card area.
